messages:
Anya: Heads-up, planning KMS design for next private deployment. want a secure cross-project pattern for envelope wrap keys and minimum-priv svcacct flow.
Mike: +1. prefer not to give node VMs direct key admin in customer projects. use an impersonation proxy in our control project.
Sarah: can we outline the exact IAM principals/roles? trying to avoid broad roles like roles/owner.
Anya: proposed layout: control-project has kms-proxy-sa. customer-project has customer-wrap-sa. runtime -> short-lived impersonation from kms-proxy-sa -> customer-wrap-sa. customer-wrap-sa has only roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on specific CryptoKey.
Linh: also use Workload Identity or STS token exchange so there's no long-lived keys on the runtime side. set impersonated token TTL to 1m-15m.
Mike: example terraform-ish IAM bits (simplified):
```
resource "google_service_account_iam_member" "proxy_token_creator" {
  service_account_id = "kms-proxy-sa@control-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  role               = "roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator"
  member             = "serviceAccount:runtime-sa@control-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "allow_customer_sa" {
  crypto_key_id = "projects/customer-project/locations/us-central1/keyRings/customer-ring/cryptoKeys/wrap-key"
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  members       = ["serviceAccount:customer-wrap-sa@customer-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```
Sarah: audit requirements: we need DATA_ACCESS audit logging for Cloud KMS to capture Encrypt/Decrypt and get the caller principal. export to a Logging Sink -> BigQuery for retention and SIEM ingestion.
Anya: logging filter we plan to use: protoPayload.methodName=("Encrypt" OR "Decrypt" OR "AsymmetricDecrypt" OR "AsymmetricEncrypt") AND resource.labels.key_ring_id:"customer-ring"
Mike: rotation question: when you rotate the wrap key, do we rewrap everything immediately or lazily? For many customers lazy rewrap is necessary.
Linh: recommended approach: new key version becomes primary for new envelopes. run a background Rewrap job that re-encrypts objects in batches. job runs with idempotency and keeps progress markers in GCS/DB.
Anya: be careful about cross-project rewrap perms: the rewrap job must impersonate customer-wrap-sa in their project (tokenCreator model). Add step in runbook to request an allowlist for rewrap-runner SA.
Sarah: monitoring: create alert on 5xx errors from Cloud KMS calls and on elevated Decrypt counts that don't match traffic curve. Also alert on iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator grant changes.
ops-bot: reminder: add rotation timeline and pre-flight checklist 30/7/1 days before rotation. include smoke tests, sample decrypt on test objects, and rollback plan.
Mike: threat note: if proxy SA is compromised, attacker could mint tokens to impersonate customer-wrap-sa. mitigations: restrictive tokenCreator binding (only runtime-sa), short TTLs, on-call pager for suspicious KMS access, and automated revocation path.
Linh: I'll open a PR with Terraform snippets plus a sample rewrap controller and share link here.
Anya: action items: mike -> update KMS runbook with proxy pattern and compromise mitigations; linh -> terraform + sink/alert IaC; sarah -> rotation checklist + SIEM mapping; ops-bot -> schedule rotation reminder.
Mike: nice. please paste PR and test results here when ready. :thumbsup:
